verdict.rationale: Gitea is self-hosted software (docs-9, docs-23) with strong access controls (docs-7/18), meaning the vendor never has access to user code/data and thus cannot use it to train models — an implicit privacy benefit. However, there is no explicit policy statement, contractual guarantee, or documentation addressing AI training data usage at all. Missing for 10: an explicit AI-training opt-out/data-usage policy, any documentation mentioning AI/ML training practices, and confirmation regarding any Gitea Cloud/managed offering's data handling.
